# Absolute path literals, one per line, blank lines and lines opening with a
# hash ignored.
#
# They live here rather than in the suite's source because the leg is right to
# refuse an absolute path literal in a gate tier test, and the case proving it
# does needs two of them as data. Record 0009 says the answer to a rule that
# refuses something legitimate is a narrower rule or a fixture, never a
# suppression on the line, and this is the fixture. Source and data under
# testdata are not compiled by the go tool and not read by the leg, so nothing
# here is a gate tier test.
#
# Provenance: written by hand for this check. The first is the file every POSIX
# example reaches for, the second is the Windows spelling with a drive letter and
# backslashes, because the suite runs on both and the leg matches both.
/etc/hosts
C:\Windows\System32
